entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely the wrong size and this is just unacceptable quality control.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the fit. I can certainly look into that for you. Could I please get your order number?
It's VF789012. Look, I've been a customer for years, and this is the first time I've gotten something so poorly made. This jersey is way too tight. I can barely get it on.

Thank you for that order number. I'm pulling it up now... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line Jersey, delivered on November 10th. So we can get this sorted, is this a preference issue with the fit, or do you believe there's a manufacturing defect?

What does it matter? It doesn't fit! I ordered a Large, it fits like a Small. I want to return it. Your website says 90 days. Are you going to give me a hard time about this? Because I will speak to a manager right now and I will post about this everywhere.

Not at all, sir. I was just clarifying the details. You are absolutely correct. Our standard policy allows for returns within 90 days, and you are well within that period. I can process this return for you immediately. Would you prefer a full refund or an exchange for a different size?
Oh. Well, fine. Just a refund. I'll handle reordering myself. I don't trust you to get the exchange right.

I understand. I have just initiated the return process for a full refund. I've sent a confirmation email to you with a prepaid shipping label attached. Please repackage the jersey, affix the label, and you can drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed.
Okay. As long as it's handled. The email better be there.
It should arrive within the next five minutes. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good afternoon.
